projectDescription: A monthly-regenerated weekly crypto index fund backtester built on backtest-kit: $1,000 split equally across the top-20 Binance USDT pairs by prior-month volume, market exposure scaled by a BTC trend gate, and the remainder parked in PAXG gold — replayed month by month from September 2020.
keyFeatures: Monthly self-contained strategy folders — no shared code between months, full reproducibility
BTC trend gate: ensemble vote of six lookback windows (20–45 days) scales basket exposure from 0 to 1
PAXG gold counter-position absorbs the fraction of the deposit the gate keeps out of crypto
Equal-weight weekly positions with time-exit after exactly one week minus one minute
Yahoo Finance daily bars sampled to the minute feed backtest-kit expects — no ccxt, no API key
Universe builder ranks Binance USDT spot pairs by prior-month volume with survivorship filters
Ticker resolver and price verifier catch Yahoo mis-mappings and anomalous price series before generation
Single script regenerates all 73 month folders from the reference month and rewrites runner scripts
Report summarizer folds all months into one table with cumulative P&L and drawdown
publicApiSurface: addFrameSchema({ frameName, interval, startDate, endDate, note })
